publication_name: Current Population Survey labour-force statistics (LN database)
access_description: Documented flat file ln.data.1.AllData and the BLS Public Data API. No data request was made for this review.
auth_requirement: Flat files have no key. Public Data API v2 registration is optional and raises the documented quota.
conditions: Cite the retrieval date for API use and state that BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived after retrieval. Do not modify figures and still present them as unaltered BLS content. Do not use the BLS logo. The API FAQ documents registered v2 limits of 500 queries a day, 50 series, 20 years and 50 requests per 10 seconds. Unregistered limits are 25 queries a day, 25 series and 10 years.
revision_behaviour: ln.txt states that most CPS estimates are final when published. Seasonally adjusted series are reestimated at year end, and the historical seasonally adjusted data for the previous five years are then revised. Not seasonally adjusted data are final when published. The current file is the latest revised seasonally adjusted rate, not a vintage panel.
unresolved_questions: The terms do not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. One current download cannot reconstruct vintages from before Aqil collects them. A third-party vintage compiler was not rights-cleared and is not in this register.
evidence_note: The BLS terms say data accessed through BLS.gov do not and should not include controls over its end use. The series page identifies LNS14000000 as the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate for people aged 16 and over. Assessed 2026-10-17 from the terms, ln.txt, the API FAQ and the series page. No observation file was downloaded.

access_description: Archived Employment Situation releases linked from the BLS archive page. No release file was downloaded for this review.
auth_requirement: No separate key is documented for the public archive pages.
conditions: Same BLS end-use conditions as the LN database: cite retrieval, include the vouch disclaimer, and do not use the logo or misrepresent modified text as unaltered BLS content.
revision_behaviour: The archive page says data in archived news releases may have been revised in subsequent releases. That warning means these copies are not established as original vintages.
unresolved_questions: Whether an individual archived file is still the first-published text was not checked. This dataset is not the LN flat file.
evidence_note: The BLS terms cover content made available through BLS.gov and do not control end use. The archive page itself supplies the revision warning. Assessed 2026-10-17.

provider_name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
publication_name: FRED and ALFRED unemployment rate UNRATE
access_description: FRED series observations API, including ALFRED realtime and vintage parameters. No API request was made for this review.
auth_requirement: A registered FRED API key is required.
conditions: API clause (l) prohibits storing, caching or archiving FRED content, providing a stored portion to a third party, or incorporating FRED content in any database, compilation, archive, cache or other medium. Clause (k) prohibits use in connection with development or training of machine-learning and AI systems, including generative AI. The v1 errors page documents 120 requests per minute.
revision_behaviour: ALFRED documents realtime periods for revised observations. Those vintages cannot be archived under the API terms.
unresolved_questions: The UNRATE series-level copyright label was not present in the fetched series-page text. The API prohibitions apply to FRED content regardless. Personal non-commercial use is described in the general terms and is not recorded here as product permission.
evidence_note: FRED API terms clauses (k) and (l), read on 2026-10-17, prohibit AI development or training and prohibit storing, caching, archiving or compiling FRED content. This row is not a licence to retain UNRATE.

publication_name: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates XML feed
access_description: Documented XML GET feed for data=daily_treasury_yield_curve. The feed page says par yields are available from 1990. No XML request was made for this review.
auth_requirement: No token is described on the feed page.
conditions: Do not apply the Fiscal Data API licence or TreasuryDirect website terms to this feed. They are different publications. A documented URL is not recorded as permission.
revision_behaviour: Revision behaviour was not stated on the pages read. These are daily par yields derived from indicative quotations, not a statistical vintage archive. Maturity columns were not confirmed from a response.
unresolved_questions: Treasury.gov site policies contain no data-licence statement for this feed. Automated collection, retention, redistribution, commercial publication and AI use therefore stay unknown.
evidence_note: The feed page documents the XML parameters and the 1990 start. The site-policies page lists required notices and does not grant copy, retention or commercial rights. Assessed 2026-10-17.

provider_name: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
publication_name: Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities
access_description: Fiscal Data API endpoint v2/accounting/od/avg_interest_rates. Monthly average interest rates on outstanding Treasury securities. No API request was made for this review.
auth_requirement: The API documentation says no user account or token is required.
conditions: The API documentation says the data is offered free, without restriction, and may be copied, adapted, redistributed or otherwise used for non-commercial or commercial purposes. That grant is the basis for the AI decisions; the page does not have a separate AI schedule. This grant does not cover Treasury.gov yield-curve XML.
revision_behaviour: The dataset page describes monthly average interest rates on unmatured interest-bearing debt. It does not describe daily par yields or statistical vintages.
unresolved_questions: None for the listed operations. This dataset remains the wrong input for a 10-year minus 3-month par or bill spread.
evidence_note: The Fiscal Data API documentation licence, read on 2026-10-17, is the evidence for copy, adaptation, redistribution and commercial use. The dataset page identifies the series as average interest rates, not the daily par yield curve.

provider_name: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
access_description: Board H.15 release and Data Download Program packages, including a preformatted Treasury constant-maturities CSV and an XML download. No file was downloaded for this review.
auth_requirement: No key is described for the public H.15 download packages.
conditions: Cite the Board. Do not use Board seals or logos. The public-domain sentence applies unless a page indicates otherwise; confirm that exception before the first download.
revision_behaviour: Revision behaviour of H.15 was not documented on the pages read. Do not treat the published history as a vintage panel until that behaviour is checked.
unresolved_questions: Exact H.15 series codes for the 10-year Treasury yield and the 3-month Treasury bill were not confirmed, so this row is not yet a method input binding. AI use is not discussed in the disclaimer.
evidence_note: The Board disclaimer, read on 2026-10-17, says that unless otherwise indicated, information on the Board website is in the public domain and may be copied and distributed without permission, and it asks users to cite the Board.
